name: photocraft
notes: Runtime pin used by server/install.mjs and the shared installer. Pinned 2026-11-04 to the v0.20.1 release (published 2026-11-03). Digests copied from the release's SHA256SUMS.txt and bytes from GitHub asset metadata; all three archives were downloaded and matched both. Every archive carries the app and photocraft-cli: since 0.18.0 the macOS DMG bundles the signed CLI at PhotoCraft.app/Contents/MacOS/photocraft-cli, so the separate photocraft-cli zip is no longer pinned. Licences: the Windows ZIP and Linux tarball carry LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE and NOTICE; the DMG carries NOTICE (Contents/Resources) and the installer supplements LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE from notices.json, copied from the tagged source. The Linux tarball also ships a bash completion named photocraft-cli, which the installer tells apart from the executable by mode. Exercised at this pin by scripts/extensions/prove-photocraft-drive.ts on darwin-arm64: clean download, size and SHA-256 check, offline tree validation, codesign, headless edits and a live window. Download only this URL; never select latest at install time.
